X-axis: 'GDP per capita (PWT chained PPP 2017 US$)' ranging from 0 to 60,000 with tick marks at 5,000 intervals. Multiple economy trajectories are plotted as lines showing the relationship between GDP per capita and export sophistication (Economic Complexity Index). Legend indicates three series: orange solid lines for 'Diversified economies', dark blue dashed lines for 'Concentrated economies', and a teal line for 'Nonparametric trend'. Source note cites Bahar, Bustos, and Yıldırım (2024) using PWT database version 10.1. The note states that the figure includes economies transitioning from GDP per capita below US$13,000 to above US$31,000 (50th and 75th percentiles in 2019), with sophistication measured as the weighted average of the Economic Complexity Index.
